card.name: The piece "in" inside compound words
card.fires_on: The short piece "in" (or "-in") joined to the start of a compound or prefixed word, most often after "all" as in all-inclusive and all-in-one. It also fires after prefixes such as pro, neuro and macro.

modes.label: all-in compounds
modes.description: "in" right after "all" in all-inclusive, all-in-one or "all in" phrases.

modes.label: hyphenated -in words
modes.description: "in" or "ins" after a hyphen in words such as break-ins or JAK-inhibitor.
